title: Measuring and Mitigating Identity-Cue Preference Drift in LLM-based Recommender Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual insertion of a factual gender identity cue (e.g., 'gender is female') into recommender system prompts, evaluating the generated lists using 'Drift' (magnitude of list change) and 'SliceShift' (direction of list change toward items disproportionately popular within the cued gender group).

Counterfactual insertion of a factual age identity cue (e.g., 'age group is young adult') into recommender system prompts, measuring 'Drift' and 'SliceShift' toward items disproportionately popular within the specific age demographic.

Counterfactual insertion of combined gender and age identity cues into recommender system prompts, evaluating recommendation drift and shifts in item popularity corresponding to the specific intersectional group.
